title: Replace fixed delays in asynchronous tests with observable synchronization
description: Deep-dive audit 2026-08-08 verified fixed Task.Delay(50/100) waits in AgentSessionTests, SemanticEmbeddingPrewarmServiceTests, and AppApiContractTests. Evidence: MemorySmith.Tests/AgentSessionTests.cs line 851, SemanticEmbeddingPrewarmServiceTests.cs line 62, AppApiContractTests.cs lines 1536-1589. Use injectable clocks, completion signals, or bounded predicate polling with diagnostics.
